title: Decisions
noConnections: No decision model connection yet. Add one in Access (Laya on this server, the local AI, or Jev).

router.label: Model choice
router.description: Before a run or a chat answer: can a cheaper model of the same runtime handle it? Also answers your own Claude Code's router.

mail.label: Sort mail
mail.description: New mail: project, kind, priority, whether it needs a reply or a task.

receipts.label: Match receipts
receipts.description: Which bank transaction pays a receipt.

general.label: General decisions
general.description: The decide tool of agents and the workflow step “Decision”.

browser.label: Optional browser stage
browser.description: Synthetic target selection for the native JEV stage. Enable this use case through the team first-stage policy; the existing project agent handles continuation.

class.connectionHint: The decision model connection from Access. A cloud service receives the text of each question.
class.connectionLocalOnly: Only a connection on this machine or in the LAN: this input must not leave it.
class.fallbackHint: Asked when the first one fails or is too slow, within the same time limit.
class.thresholdHint: Below this confidence nothing is decided and the previous behaviour applies. Default {value}.
class.timeoutHint: An answer later than this counts as none. Default {value}.
class.storeInput: Keep the input in the log
class.storeInputHint: Otherwise the log keeps only a fingerprint of it.
class.storeInputNever: This kind never keeps its input.
class.contextThresholdHint: From this probability that the request builds on the earlier conversation, the configured model stays. Default 50 %.
class.evalHint: {cases} labelled cases, asked as the feature asks them. Passes at {precision} precision and {coverage} coverage.
class.enabledHint: Only after a passed evaluation on the chosen connection.
class.stats: Last 7 days: {total} questions, {decided} decided, {unsure} unsure, {failed} without answer, {wrong} of {corrected} corrected wrong · median {latency} · {cost}

reasons.no_eval: Evaluate it on this connection first.
reasons.eval_failed: The last evaluation on this connection did not pass.
reasons.eval_threshold: The last evaluation used a higher threshold; evaluate again.

mail.projectHint: Suggest the project, or move mail filed under Home there at once.
mail.taskHint: When a mail asks for something to be done: suggest a task in its project, or create it.
mail.agentHint: That task assigned to an agent, who then works on it.
mail.receiptsHint: The PDF and XML attachments of an invoice go to the project's receipts.

router.agentsHint: Off by default. On: runs and chat answers without a model of their own may use a cheaper model of the agent's runtime.
router.recentHint: What the model choice did, and why.
router.noRoutesHint: Once a model choice happens, it shows here.

log.emptyHint: They appear here once a kind is switched on.

firstStage.title: Optional Jev first stage
firstStage.hint: Jev may answer small typed judgments first. When off, uncertain, unavailable or too slow, the existing decision path continues. Complex work keeps the assigned specialist; this does not change agents or model defaults.
firstStage.connection: Jev connection (changing it switches this stage off)
firstStage.cloudHint: Enable only the use cases whose input may be sent to Jev in the cloud. A passed evaluation is required. Their existing class switch and fallback still apply; local-only classes are excluded.
firstStage.cooldown: Jev is temporarily skipped after repeated service failures. The existing path remains available.
firstStage.allow: Allow Jev cloud first stage for {name}
